blocks.html: For the purposes of this Chapter, the definition of “outdoor amusement park” set forth in Section 12-10 shall be modified to also include recreational attractions, rides, games and other forms of entertainment for visitors of all ages, as found in North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) industry code 71311 (Amusement and Theme Parks) that are enclosed within a building or other structure.
